topic: Validation Positive Target Scorable Catalog Eligibility Ceiling
problem_statement: Audit the catalog overlap between M05 item factors and held-out validation positive targets to determine theoretical bounds on collaborative filtering recommendation accuracy.
root_cause: 3,491 catalog movies have 0 ratings in Train and therefore possess no M05 item factor vector.
solution_or_decision: Audit shows exactly 30 out of 109,779 positive validation targets belong to these 3,491 unscoreable catalog movies. Under the strict ALS-only policy, these 30 users receive miss (0.0) while being strictly retained in the positive cohort denominator, establishing a theoretical ceiling of 99.9727% for pure collaborative filtering.
evidence: Catalog audit: 62,423 full movies, 58,932 scorable (94.41%), 3,491 unscoreable (5.59%). Positive targets in unscoreable movies: 30 / 109,779 users. Max possible HR: 99.9727%.
